why: Fire Dragon's cast (nine mana: four Forests, three Mountains and a Forest wearing A-Find the Path's {T}: Add two mana of any one color) is found only by gorge's prefix search (the planner prices no granted ability); a Chromatic Star's {1},{T},sacrifice gap beside the grant makes the search walk the Star's colour and funding branches and exhaust its 160-node budget (plain and phased) with no script, so gorge offers pass and Enormous Baloth alone, while the kernel offers the cast; without the Star gap the search finds a three-step script (CR 605.3b, 601.2g)
